Product Details:
Water Gel 50g 
(for oily to Combination skin)
* Please take note bottle has changed to new packaging write "Shirojyun Premium"
 Exp date: 02 / 2028

Water Cream 50g 
* Please take note bottle write "Premium Whitening Water Cream"
(for normal to dry skin)
 Exp date: 02 / 2028

Glowing, dewy skin is yours! Our triple brightening formula works to unveil a brilliant complexion.

TRIPLE BRIGHTENING FORMULA
Niacinamide, alpha-arbutin and vitamin C lightening dark spots and acne scars, even out skin tone, and strengthen skin for a glowing, dewy complexion.

3 TYPES OF HYALURONIC ACID
Three types of Hyaluronic Acid provide intense moisture, leaving skin feeling soft, hydrated and more supple after cleansing

TRIPLE ANTI-POLLUTION FORMULA
Helps to purify skin against environmental pollution, forming a protective barrier that shields skin from external pollutants

How to Use:
STEP 1
After Hada Labo Lotion & Essence, apply a sufficient amount

STEP 2
Apply evenly on face and neck

STEP 3
Gently massage into face

STEP 4
Pat to improve absorption into face

Ingredients:
Water, Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Butylene Glycol, Cyclopentasiloxane, 1,2-Hexanediol, Dimethicone, Hydroxyacetophenone, PEG-32, Isononyl Isononanoate, Bis-Diglyceryl Polyacyladipate-2, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/​VP Copolymer, Sodium Polyacryloyldimethyl Taurate, Hydrogenated Polydecene, Dimethiconol, Alpha-Arbutin, Styrene/​Acrylates Copolymer, Centella Asiatica Extract, Honey Extract, Urea, Trehalose, Scutellaria Baicalensis Root Extract, Polygonum Cuspidatum Root Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Glyceryl Acrylate/​Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Trideceth-10, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Pvm/​Ma Copolymer, Serine, Pentylene Glycol, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Phenoxyethanol, Candida Bombicola/​Glucose/​Methyl Rapeseedate Ferment, Algin, Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Disodium Phosphate, Glyceryl Polyacrylate, Pullulan, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Propylene Glycol, Potassium Phosphate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Potassium Sorbate, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Leaf Extract, Sebacic Acid, 10-Hydroxydecanoic Acid, 1,10-Decanediol
